title: Board approves a year-end bonus dividend for members
summary: The board approved a year-end bonus dividend, paid to every member with a savings account or loan in good standing.
body:
At its September meeting, the board approved a $1.2 million bonus dividend for members. It will be paid in December to every member with a share savings account, a certificate or a loan in good standing.

As a member-owned credit union, we return part of each year's earnings to the people who use us. The average member will receive about $48.

title: Nominations open for three board seats
summary: Any member 18 or older can apply to serve on the volunteer board. Applications are due December 1.
body:
Three seats on our volunteer board of directors are up for election at the March 2027 annual meeting. Any member who is 18 or older and in good standing can apply. The nominating committee will interview candidates in January.

Nomination packets are in the member area, or you can pick one up at any branch.

title: Wren Lake branch adds Saturday drive-thru hours
summary: Starting October 3, the Wren Lake drive-thru is open Saturdays from 9 am to 2 pm.
body: Members asked, and starting October 3 the Wren Lake drive-thru is open on Saturdays from 9 am to 2 pm, the same as the lobby.

title: Kestrel Valley gives $85,000 to local schools and food pantries
summary: Our community fund supported 14 schools and four food pantries this year.
body: This year our community fund gave $85,000 to 14 schools and four food pantries across the valley, chosen by a committee of members and staff.

title: Certificate special on the 12-month Add-On
summary: Our 12-month Add-On certificate now pays 4.10% APY, and you can add to it during the term.
body: The 12-month Add-On certificate now pays 4.10% APY with a $500 minimum. You can add deposits at any time during the term.

title: Mobile app update brings card controls and travel notices
summary: Turn your card on and off, set spending limits and tell us you are traveling, all in the app.
body: The latest update to the mobile app adds card controls: turn a card off if you misplace it, set limits for a teen's card, and add travel notices.
